mission.title: Monkey Wrench Roundup
mission.description: Intercept one of the imposter Agents' black boxes.

phase.briefing: Warrior, with the help of recent intelligence, Commander Lock has determined that the imposter Agents are behind the recent hardline sabotage. However, their motives and methods remain obscure. We want you to intercept one of those mysterious "black boxes" that they've been lugging around the sabotage sites--the Commander thinks that these boxes may hold the key to the imposter Agents' activities.

enter.say: Intel spotted a band of those imposter Agents lugging one of their "black boxes" into that building. The Agents left without the box, so it should still be on the premises.

talk.say: Too late, human. The box is mine now! Take 'em, boys!
Watch out! It seems that they're willing to fight for that black box.

done.say: The Exile group leader that you just defeated should have the black box somewhere on his person.

objective.text: Get the black box from Burdette

done.say: That's the black box that we're looking for, Warrior. Find a hardline and upload it to us.

objective.text: Upload the black box at a hardline

done.say: Good. Receiving your uploaded data now.

mission.finish: You've done well, operative. Thanks to you, Zion's engineers will be able to start decompiling that black box right away. The mystery of the imposter Agents will finally be solved!
